## Repeater Nation app

Repeater Nation on your phone or tablet: the full website with a tab bar for Home, Repeaters, Nets, Clubs and More.

**Android:** download the `.apk` below on your phone or tablet and open it. If asked, allow installs from your browser.

**iPhone and iPad:** download the `-unsigned.ipa` and install it with Sideloadly. Steps are in [docs/ios-install.md](https://github.com/WSIQ838/repeater-nation-app/blob/main/docs/ios-install.md). The app has to be reinstalled every 7 days, an Apple rule for apps installed without a paid developer account.

This is an early version. It shows the Repeater Nation website inside the app. Screens from the design in `index.html` will replace the website pages one at a time.
